nodes.title: FOA Certified Fiber Optic Technician (CFOT)
nodes.description: Fiber optic communication systems, terminology, components, and installation. Splicing, termination, and testing. Essential for building the physical mesh substrate.

nodes.title: APICS Certified in Planning and Inventory Management
nodes.description: Internal operations, inventory management, and scheduling. Mapping the Mycelial Oracle and TEND ledger to professional inventory standards.

nodes.title: InterNACHI Certified Professional Property Inspector
nodes.description: Inspecting residential properties for safety, structural integrity, and system performance. Mapping habitat engineering to professional property standards.

nodes.title: SCA Barista Skills: Foundation
nodes.description: The fundamentals of professional coffee preparation. Setting your grinder, milk techniques, and health/safety. Linked to the Ubuntu Stewardship track.

nodes.title: Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification
nodes.description: Architecture, ecosystem, and data loading in the Snowflake Data Cloud. Mapping value topology and oracle predictive models to modern data warehousing.
